Sorry, I didn't catch that. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?

Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats. Is that right?
Yes. Four people. Father needs help leaving because of his manual wheelchair. No water inside yet.
